acceptance: An idle transition with live < fleet.min_lanes emits LOOP_ORCH_POOL_UNDERFILLED at WARN (red test first)
evolve wave watch prints pool transitions and every loop.wave WARN
No UNDERFILLED WARN when live >= min_lanes or when the operator brake is engaged
fix: TDD first: a fake pool transition stream at live 1 of 4 gives exactly one UNDERFILLED WARN per idle transition below min_lanes; wave watch prints the pool lines. Register the code in the signalcenter registry. Update wave-operations.md and the orchestrator package note. 100% coverage on changed functions, zero comments.
summary: LOOP_ORCH_POOL_IDLE is INFO and nothing compares the live count with fleet.min_lanes (4). In wave 130 the pool emitted POOL_IDLE seven times at live 1-3 of target 4 over three hours, and evolve wave watch printed only per-cycle phase lines (0 of 7 idle, 2 deadline and 1 stall events), so a starved pool looked the same as a busy one. Add a LOOP_ORCH_POOL_UNDERFILLED WARN (fields live, target, min_lanes, ready count) when a slot stays free while live < min_lanes, and make wave watch print every loop.wave WARN and the pool transitions (launched, exited, backfilled, idle, deadline, stalled), so a console watching the wave is woken by it.
title: An idle pool below fleet.min_lanes raises a WARN, and wave watch prints the pool events
